shared_elements: boat/ship shown in profile with upcurved prows
quadruped animals in profile (A more clearly)
small repeated marks/strokes along a line (crew strokes / hatching)
justification: The clearest correspondence is the profile boat with strongly upcurved prows and rows of short strokes along its hull, which appears at the base of A and repeatedly in B, together with small schematic human figures in both. Beyond that the content diverges: A organises animals, riders and figures into stacked horizontal registers beneath arcaded architectural framing and renders bodies with modelled, textured infill, while B scatters oversized outline figures carrying large concentric discs among free-floating cup-mark dots with no framing or registers.
